focus: Use the low-rank causal memory signal to modulate the FFN neuron
design_goal: Design a novel neuron where the low-rank causal memory changes activation shape or thresholds per token
constraints: Keep sequence cost linear. Target <=3 percent extra params and <=5 percent VRAM. Fit into CausalMultiScaleLowRankConvMemoryBlock.

focus: Use multi-scale conv branch statistics inside the neuron
design_goal: Design a neuron whose response depends on local/multi-scale causal context without attention
constraints: No seq x seq attention. Reuse conv outputs or cheap summaries. Preserve baseline mixer and make implementation small.

focus: Token-adaptive mixture of a few learned nonlinear bases
design_goal: Design a neuron that learns a small bank of nonlinear basis responses and chooses per token/channel cheaply
constraints: Must be more novel than SiLU/ReLU/GELU/SwiGLU. Avoid large MoE routing. Keep params close to baseline.

focus: Exploit low-rank competition/sparsity inside channel expansion
design_goal: Design a neuron that encourages useful competition among expanded FFN features
constraints: No top-k sorting over sequence. Cheap local channel operations only. Stable under fp16.

focus: Use causal running state for dynamic thresholds or gain
design_goal: Design a neuron whose threshold/gain evolves causally from prior tokens
constraints: Must be parallelizable with cumsum/conv/scan-like tensor ops. No recurrent Python loop over tokens.

focus: Represent features as amplitude/phase or signed magnitude pairs
design_goal: Design a neuron that separates magnitude and sign/phase to improve extrapolation through conv-memory blocks
constraints: Parameter efficient. Explain why it may help long-context language modeling.

focus: Novel neuron focused on stable gradients at 5B-token scale
design_goal: Design a nonlinearity/block neuron that reduces dead channels
column6: Must preserve high sample efficiency. Include initialization and clipping details.

focus: Make neuron aware of sampled-vocab/factorized head bottleneck
design_goal: Design an FFN neuron that improves representation under factorized output and sampled-vocab anchor loss
constraints: No changes to loss or tokenizer. Neuron/block-local only.
